MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture covers classes of amorphous materials, including silicate, borate, and chalcogenide glasses, and their structures, properties, and applications, discussing network formers, modifiers, and intermediates and their impact on glass properties.
